derived_from: ledger/postmortems.json (23 plans; 12 unfavourable misses). These modes were derived from the same history Llull is first run on, so scores on it are in-sample.

modes.definition: Plan sized a pool without checking the gates an order must pass first (status, held text, custody, citable ending instrument, current predicate).
modes.question: Which inputs must each item hold for this step to succeed, and how many items hold all of them today?
modes.mechanical_check: Domesday census: forecast p90 and any large number in the plan vs the joint ceiling; requires_unmeasured is auto_fail

modes.definition: Rates measured on the easiest family/pilot (Codification revocation swarm, X1's 10% eligible) were transferred to a harder population.
modes.question: Where was the rate this step uses measured, and is this pool the same class (not the easiest family or pilot)?
modes.mechanical_check: reference class pool vs plan pool; a class with n_studies < 3 or a per-batch spread over 3x is flagged

modes.definition: Producer savings were eaten by review, correction or new contrary-source research.
modes.question: Who pays after the producer (review, correction, contrary-source research), and is the saving net of them?
modes.mechanical_check: a usd_*/minutes_* forecast must name producer AND reviewer cost

modes.definition: A hit rate, saving share or minutes figure was assumed, not measured.
modes.question: Which number in this step has no measured source?
modes.mechanical_check: every steering number must be a forecast with a measured reference class

modes.definition: Success counted in a proxy (payload tokens, bytes, packets, agent-minutes, certificates) instead of ready orders or billed $.
modes.question: Does success count ready orders, accepted items or billed dollars (not tokens, bytes, packets, certificates)?
modes.mechanical_check: quantity must be in the allowed outcome units; proxy words are flagged

modes.definition: Steps or source lists treated as independent when they are gated or dependent.
modes.question: Do the steps or source lists gate each other? Is a stated bound guaranteed or only a tendency?
modes.mechanical_check: census product-of-marginals vs joint count (1.5x rule)

modes.definition: Source access assumed (robots, Cloudflare, permissions, host routes) before a one-request check.
modes.question: Has one request to each host succeeded this week (robots.txt, viewer, Cloudflare)?
modes.mechanical_check: not mechanical offline; the network gate is not shipped

modes.definition: Pass rests on a reviewer from the same model family / single pass; quality rate not independently measured.
modes.question: Is the pass rate from a reviewer of the same model family in a single pass?
modes.mechanical_check: plan names reviewer and producer models; same family and single pass needs an answer

modes.definition: Pessimistic miss: a cheaper route (archive mirror, script) was not in the plan.
modes.question: Is there a cheaper route: an archive mirror, an index, a script instead of agents?
modes.mechanical_check: a zero-agent job that already produces the input; CDX/Common Crawl lookup (network)

modes.definition: Saving counted from a policy change the owner had not approved.
modes.question: Does this step count a rule change or decision the owner has not approved?
modes.mechanical_check: an owner decision named in the step must cite an approval line in HANDOFF/
